about: The Workbench icons of the BumpRace drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/bumprace.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a silver racer with a glowing thruster flying through a green-walled cave towards a blue teleport ring) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/bumprace.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. BumpRace-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, BumpRace.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's BumpRace.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for COPYING.txt, README-BumpRace.txt, AUTHORS.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the Data and User drawers' icon.
